title: AutoHebb: Self-Modifying Neural Networks that Zero-Shot Infer and Continually Learn
abstract: arXiv:2610.40757v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Humans and animals have a unique capacity to generalize and learn in novel circumstances, including "0-shot" inference (ZI) and continual learning (CL) -- two powerful cognitive abilities. Despite this importance, efforts to model ZI and CL are seriously limited in several ways. First, existing models typically lack components critical to ZI and CL in the brain, namely, strong inductive biases (for ZI) and autonomous control of learning (for CL). Second, models can be less tractable to analysis if model components are overly complex (lacking simplicity), or too task-restricted if model components are overly bespoke (lacking expressivity). Here we introduce autonomous Hebbian networks ("AutoHebb"), a class of online learning feedforward neural networks that realize strong inductive biases and autonomously controlled learning, and are both simple and expressive. tldr: 本文提出AutoHebb——一类兼具强归纳偏置与学习自主控制能力的自主赫布在线学习前馈神经网络，在保持简洁性和表达能力的同时，实现了零样本推理与持续学习。
